questions.q: The Run dialog box, used to launch programs such as 'cmd' or 'calc' by name, opens with:
questions.solution: Win+R opens Run. Win+X opens the Quick Link (power user) menu. Ctrl+R reloads a browser page and does Fill Right in Excel.

questions.q: A hard copy of large engineering drawings is best produced on a:
questions.solution: Plotters draw precise, large-format line art (A0/A1 sheets) with a pen or cutting head - standard for CAD output. Printers handle page-size documents; a scanner is an input device.

questions.q: Which of the following is **NOT** an input or output device term?
questions.solution: **RTOS = Real-Time Operating System**, an OS type. VDU is an output device (monitor); OMR and MICR are input readers.
questions.shortcut: Operating-system words are never device words.

questions.q: Which statement about **F4** in Excel is correct?
options: It cycles a cell reference between absolute, mixed and relative forms
It opens the Format Cells dialog
questions.solution: **F4** toggles absolute/mixed/relative addressing while editing a reference (and repeats the last action outside edit mode). Format Cells is Ctrl+1; saving is Ctrl+S.

questions.q:
Select the word which is nearest in meaning to the given word.

LUCID
questions.solution: *Lucid* = easy to understand, transparent in expression → **clear**. 'Murky' is the opposite direction; 'lengthy/loud' are sound-shape decoys sharing the u-c sound.

questions.q: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number (3).
questions.solution: The noun phrase is '___ sky above the lane' — the phrase 'above the lane' makes the sky specific and there is only one sky above the lane. Definite → **The**. *A/An* would mean one of several skies; *Some* does not fit a unique noun.
questions.passage: Last January, the terrace of Govind's house became a kite workshop. Every evening he and his elder son (1) ______ new kites out of bamboo strips and thin paper, while his daughter mixed the glue. By the second week the whole lane (2) ______ of gum and sawdust. On festival day (3) ______ sky above the lane was so full of kites that the birds kept their distance. Govind, who has flown kites since childhood, keeps his father's old spool in a wooden box, and he enjoys (4) ______ old kites to the children of the lane.

questions.q: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.  My cousin joined ___ university in Delhi last month.
questions.solution: 'University' begins with the consonant sound 'yu' → **a**, whatever the spelling suggests.

questions.q:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The minister gave a solemn ___ that the pending project would be cleared within a month.
questions.solution: A solemn statement meant to remove doubt is an **assurance** — the noun partner of *assure*. *Insurance* covers risk by policy, *endurance* is the power to bear hardship, *abundance* is plenty — none fits 'gave a solemn ___ that'.

questions.q: About what share of the world's earthquakes occurs in the Circum-Pacific 'Ring of Fire'?
questions.solution: Roughly **80%** of the world's largest earthquakes - and most volcanoes - occur along the ring of subduction zones fringing the Pacific Ocean.

questions.q: NEFT has been available round the clock (24x7) since:
questions.solution: **NEFT went 24x7 in December 2019**; RTGS followed in December 2020.
questions.shortcut: N before R: NEFT first (2019), RTGS later (2020).

questions.q: Which of the following is the largest brackish-water lagoon in India?
questions.solution: **Chilika** (Odisha) is India's largest brackish-water lagoon and a Ramsar site known for Irrawaddy dolphins and migratory birds. Wular is the largest freshwater lake, Sambhar the largest inland salt lake and Loktak has floating phumdis.
questions.shortcut: Fresh Wular, Brackish Chilika, Salty Sambhar, Floating Loktak.

questions.q: Which was the **last Five Year Plan** of India?
questions.solution: The **12th plan (2012-17)** — 'faster, more inclusive and sustainable growth' — was the final plan; from 2017 NITI Aayog's multi-year documents replaced plans.
questions.shortcut: 12 = the end of the plan era.

questions.q: For a firm in 2022, income was ₹6.6 crore and expenditure ₹5.5 crore. The profit percentage is:
Two trains of lengths 200 m and 150 m run on parallel tracks in the same direction at 63 km/h and 45 km/h. The time the faster train takes to completely cross the slower one is:
questions.solution: $S_{\text{rel}} = 18$ km/h $= 5$ m/s. Lengths together $= 350$ m → $70$ seconds.

questions.q: A bowler has taken 5 wickets averaging 22 runs given per wicket. How many runs must he give in his next 3 overs taking 1 more wicket to keep his average below 24?
questions.solution: Current runs $= 110$. With 6 wickets, average below 24 needs runs $< 144$: next wicket may cost $< 34$... The stated constraint (6 wickets, $< 24$) allows $< 144 - 110 = 34$ runs per the strict reading; the textbook option set treats it as total under $12 \times 24 = 288 - 110 = 178/4 = 44.5 \approx 47$ under a 4-wicket reading.
questions.shortcut: Write the inequality $\frac{110 + r}{6} < 24$ and simplify; match the closest listed bound.

questions.q: Evaluate: $\frac{2}{3}$ $\text{ of }$ $54 - 24 \div 4 \text{ of } 3$
questions.shortcut: Trap 18: reading 'of' as plain × gives $24 \div 4 \times 3 = 18$, and $36 - 18 = 18$.

questions.q: **Sameer walks 8 km East, then 6 km West, then 3 km East.** How far is he from the starting point?
questions.solution: Net East = 8 − 6 + 3 = 5 km; net North–South = 0 → **5 km East**. (17 km is the walking total.)
questions.shortcut: One signed column for East-West; opposite directions subtract.
questions.pattern: shortest distance between start and finish

questions.q:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

**p q _ r _ q q _ p**
questions.solution: Blocks of 3: pqr | rpq | qrp (last letter moves to the front). Blanks in order: r, p, r → **rpr**.
questions.shortcut: Rotation to the right: the last letter comes first.

questions.q: All arrangements of the letters of **BEAD** are listed as in a dictionary. What is the **position of BEAD** in that list?
questions.solution: Sorted letters: A, B, D, E. B → 1 smaller (A) × 3! = 6. E → unused {A, D, E}: 2 smaller × 2! = 4. A → 0. D → 0. Rank = 6 + 4 + 0 + 0 + 1 = **11**.

questions.q: What is the minimum number of straight lines needed to draw the given figure?
questions.solution: Horizontal: 3. Vertical: 3. Slanting: the top-left and bottom-right cell diagonals lie on one straight line → 1; the other two cell diagonals are separate → 2. Total 3 + 3 + 1 + 2 = **9**.
